steps.title: Classroom Introductions and Expectations
steps.description: The class establishes a shared tone by discussing participation and general classroom expectations. Each student also shares how they prefer to learn and prepare for lessons.

steps.title: Learning Habits and Classroom Support
steps.description: The class discusses general learning habits and ways students can seek or offer support. The conversation also covers what makes each student confident or nervous about schoolwork in general. Ms. Sunday also explains how lesson material is built up step by step so every student can understand it, and students share how they usually prepare for school assessments in general.

steps.title: Reviewing Recent Material
steps.description: The class reviews recent material and discusses how students handle unclear topics. The class also discusses how reviewing the material will help them prepare for the announced end-of-week written test.

steps.title: Pengumuman Ujian
steps.description: Ms. Sunday announces that a written test will take place on Day 6 and asks the class to prepare using the material discussed during the week.

steps.title: Participation and Preparation
steps.description: The class discusses preparation routines and respectful participation during lessons.

steps.title: Perubahan Aturan Kelas
steps.description: Ms. Sunday announces that students must raise a hand and wait to be acknowledged before speaking during class discussion.

steps.title: Working with Different Classmates
steps.description: The class considers how students can share ideas and contribute when working with classmates. The class also considers how groups decide who guides the explanation and how classmates evaluate each contribution fairly.

steps.title: Diskusi Kelompok
steps.description: Ms. Sunday assigns the students a group discussion and asks each student to contribute to a shared explanation of the current lesson.

steps.title: Responsibility and Classroom Initiative
steps.description: The class discusses everyday responsibility, cooperation, and constructive initiative in the classroom. The discussion includes what makes a classmate dependable when taking responsibility as class leader.

steps.title: Pemilihan Ketua Kelas
steps.description: Ms. Sunday asks the class to nominate and discuss a student who could take responsibility as class leader.

steps.title: Final Review and Study Reflection
steps.description: The class reviews the week's learning and discusses general approaches to checking understanding. Students compare their preparation strategies right before the scheduled written test begins.

steps.title: Ujian Harian
steps.description: Ms. Sunday begins the announced written test and asks each student to respond based on their preparation and understanding.
